description: Each change adds a changelog fragment that the release task assembles into CHANGELOG.md (#290)
no_spec_change_rationale: No requirement describes the changelog's layout; LIFE-16 is unchanged, and the change is repository tooling, its tests, the release doc and the workflow skill's fast path
acceptance_criteria: A change adds its entry as changelog.d/<date>-<change-id>.md and CHANGELOG.md is not edited by the change

answers.constraints: Assembly must be deterministic and must never drop existing CHANGELOG.md text
